problemStatement.plain: A number is *abundant* when the sum of its proper divisors exceeds the number itself (equivalently $\sigma(n) > 2n$). Even abundant numbers are common — $12$ is the smallest. Odd abundant numbers are far rarer; the smallest is $945 = 3^3 \cdot 5 \cdot 7$. We want a machine-checked proof that $945$ is abundant and that no smaller odd number is.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: smallest_odd_abundant proved axiom-free and build-verified (PR #26159); kernel-reducible sigmaFast technique answers abundant-number-oq-01 open question.
builtItems: sigmaFast / sigmaAux: kernel-reducible divisor sum by structural recursion on ℕ (Proofs/AbundantNumberOQ02.lean:33,39)
sigmaFast_eq_sigma: sigmaFast n = ∑_{d∣n} d for n≠0 (AbundantNumberOQ02.lean:56)
not_abundant_odd_below_945: ∀ n<945, Odd n → sigmaFast n ≤ 2n by kernel decide (AbundantNumberOQ02.lean:89)
smallest_odd_abundant: IsLeast {n | Odd n ∧ Nat.Abundant n} 945, axiom-free (AbundantNumberOQ02.lean:96)
insights: The obstruction to proving 945 is the smallest odd abundant number is purely computational: Mathlib's Nat.Abundant is decidable only via Finset/Multiset divisor folds whose kernel whnf reduction blows up well before n=945, so a direct decide is infeasible.

Replacing the REPRESENTATION of sigma (not the predicate) with a structurally-recursive ℕ surrogate sigmaFast (no Finset/Multiset at reduction time) makes the bounded check ∀ n<945, Odd n → ¬Abundant n feasible by a single kernel decide, keeping it axiom-free (no native_decide / Lean.ofReduceBool).
Lean gotcha: a doc-comment /-- -/ cannot be directly followed by set_option ... in (parse error: expected lemma); set_option must precede the doc-comment.
The bounded decide over ~470 odd cases exceeds the default 200000 maxHeartbeats in the elaborator whnf check; raising maxHeartbeats (10000000) lets it complete in ~74s build.
nextSteps: Prove the odd abundant numbers are infinite (every odd multiple of 945 is abundant via abundant-number-oq-01 closure), giving an injective odd-abundant family.
Extend the kernel-reducible-σ technique to the smallest odd abundant number not divisible by 3 (5391411025) — likely out of reach for kernel decide, may need structural argument.
